auth.welcomeTitle: Your old things are someone's treasure
auth.welcomeBody: List what you no longer need, find what you do, and trade straight across. No money changes hands.
auth.emailHelp: We email you a six-digit code. No password to remember.
auth.errorGeneric: That did not go through. Check the address and try again.
auth.codeSentBody: We sent a six-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it here — it expires in an hour.
auth.errorBadCode: That code did not work. Check the digits and type it again — the newest email is the one that counts, and it stays good for an hour.
auth.errorRateLimited: That is a few too many tries. Codes are capped by the hour, so give it a while before asking for another.
auth.errorBadEmail: That address did not look right to us. Check it and try again.
auth.inviteHint: Optional. If a friend invited you, their code goes here — they earn points once you finish your first swap.
auth.inviteHelp: Optional — leave it blank if you came on your own.
auth.errorNoAccount: We have no account for that address. Sign up and it takes a moment.
auth.errorHaveAccount: That address already has an account. Log in instead.
auth.nameHelp: What other swappers will see. A first name is plenty.
auth.terms: By continuing you agree to the terms and privacy notice.
auth.signInSub: Your old things are someone’s treasure.

onboarding.step1Body: Bartefy is a straight trade: your thing for their thing. Here is how it works.
onboarding.step2Body: Photograph something you no longer need. Say what you would like in return — or leave it open to offers.
onboarding.step3Body: Swipe through finds near you. Keep the ones you want; pass on the rest. Nobody is told when you pass.
onboarding.step4Body: When they say yes, a chat opens. Agree a spot, meet up, and both confirm the swap. No money changes hands.
onboarding.cityBody: We only show finds you could realistically go and collect.
onboarding.tasteBody: Pick a few. This only shapes your first few cards — you can change it any time.
onboarding.finishBody: Start by listing one thing. A profile with a find on the table gets far more offers.

hunt.title: Today's finds
hunt.offerNone: List a find to trade with
hunt.detailEmpty: Pick up a card to see its details.
hunt.emptyBody: You have seen every find within {{radius}} km. Widen the range, or list something of your own — new finds arrive daily.
hunt.hintSwipe: Swipe left to pass. Swipe right to put one of yours on the table.
hunt.hintKeys: Or use ← and → on your keyboard
hunt.matchBody: You both want what the other has.
hunt.offerSent: Noted. If they want yours too, it is a match.
hunt.superSent: Super offer sent — it is at the top of their list
hunt.multiSent: {{count}} offers sent — they pick the one they want
hunt.boosted: Boosted — your find is in front of more people for a day.

item.reservedNote: Reserved while another swap finishes. We will tell you if it comes back.
item.notFoundBody: It may have been swapped, paused or taken down. Have a look at what else is around.
item.removeTitle: Take this find off the table?
item.removeBody: It stops appearing in decks. Anyone already talking to you about it keeps the conversation.

add.title: List a find
add.photosHelp: Three or four honest photos beat one perfect one. Show any wear — it saves awkwardness later.
add.descriptionPlaceholder: Where it came from, how it has been used, anything that is not obvious from the photos.
add.categoryLabel: What kind of thing is it?
add.wantsLabel: What would you like in return?
add.wantsHelp: Nobody has a catalogue — pick the directions you would trade toward, and say anything specific below.
add.limitTitle: You have reached your listing limit
add.limitBody: Free members keep {{count}} finds on the table at once. Pause one, or upgrade for more room.
add.photoStepTitle: Show it. One photo is enough to start.
add.photoStepHelp: Daylight, no styling needed. The worn bits are the point.
add.wantsStepTitle: What would you like for it?
add.wantsStepHelp: Rough is fine. This is what puts your find in front of the right people.
add.publishFailed: That did not save. Check your signal and try again.
add.needDetails: Add a name, a few words and a category first
add.categoryHelp: Pick as many as fit. It is how people find it.
add.wantsHeading: What would you like in return?
add.wantsAnythingHelp: Leave the categories empty and any offer is welcome.
add.wantsNotePlaceholder: Ideally a soldering station, but surprise me.
add.wantsNoteHelp: A wish, not a promise — people will offer what they actually have.
add.publishedBody: Your find is in the deck. You’ll hear when someone offers a swap.
add.heldBody: A person checks the photo before this one goes live. It usually takes a few hours.
add.boostBody: Put this find at the top of every nearby deck for a day.
add.boostDone: Boosted — top of the deck for 24 hours.
add.showIt: Show it. One photo is enough to start.
add.onlyPhoto: A photo and a name are all it needs — the rest helps the right people find it.
add.needUpload: Wait for the photo to finish uploading.

swaps.title: Matches
swaps.emptyBody: When you and someone else both want what the other has, the swap opens here.
swaps.pickBody: Choose one from the list to see the thread and what happens next.

chat.systemMatched: You matched — you both want what the other has.
chat.confirmFailed: That did not go through. Try again in a moment.
chat.voiceDenied: Bartefy needs the microphone to record. You can still type.
chat.voiceFailed: That recording did not send. Try again.

arrange.title: Arrange the swap
arrange.whereHelp: Pick somewhere public and busy. We never store home addresses.
arrange.safetyBody: Meet in daylight in a public place. Tell someone where you are going. Trust your gut — you can back out at any point, for any reason, at no cost.
arrange.heading: Where will you two meet?
arrange.modeMeetHelp: Most swaps happen face to face, somewhere public.
arrange.modePostHelp: Prepaid label, tracking in the thread. Both send on the same day.
arrange.placeHelp: We never suggest home addresses, and the thread strips them if typed.
arrange.placePlaceholder: A cafe, a market, a station entrance…
arrange.oneTap: They get one tap to accept, or to suggest another time.
arrange.needPlace: Add a place first — anywhere public will do.
arrange.proposeFailed: That did not send. Try again in a moment.
arrange.postMessage: I will post mine — shall we both send on the same day?

confirm.title: Did the swap happen?
confirm.rateBody: Ratings stay hidden until you have both rated, so nobody is swayed.
confirm.blindNote: Neither of you sees the other's rating until you have both left one.

trouble.title: What went wrong?
trouble.body: Nothing is decided automatically. A person reads every report.
trouble.reasonNotAsDescribed: The item was not as described
trouble.freeNote: Reporting, blocking, and backing out are always free.
trouble.heading: What happened with this swap?
trouble.subtitle: Nothing here is public, and nothing is decided by a machine.
trouble.consequenceChangedMind: We cancel it and both finds go back into the hunt.
trouble.consequenceNoShow: You can reschedule once, or close it with a note only we see.
trouble.consequenceNotAsDescribed: Add a photo or two. We freeze the swap and a person reads the thread.
trouble.consequenceUnsafe: We block them immediately. You do not have to explain anything to them.
trouble.evidenceLabel: Add a photo, if you have one
trouble.nextBody: The swap freezes tonight. {{name}} sees that you raised something, not what you wrote. We reply within two days, and neither rating counts until then.
trouble.consequenceAskedForMoney: Bartefy is trade-only. We read the thread and act on it — you do not have to pay anything, ever.

profile.title: Profile
profile.inviteBody: Share it. You both get credit when they finish their first swap.
profile.inviteSub: +{{n}} pts when a friend finishes their first swap
profile.othersNote: This is all anyone sees when they tap your name — never your finds, your points or your tier.
profile.noFinished: No finished swaps yet. They show up here once you both confirm.
profile.nameHelp: This is what people see on your card and in chats.

membership.title: Membership
membership.cancelAny: Cancel any time. Swaps already agreed always finish under the limits you had.
membership.alwaysFreeBody: Reporting, blocking, meeting safely, confirming a handover, rating, reading your threads, and finishing a swap you already agreed.
membership.headline: Swapping is free. Reach is not.
membership.subhead: Listing, hunting, chatting, meeting, confirming, rating, blocking and reporting stay free forever. What you can pay for is a bigger map and being seen sooner.
membership.postage: Prepaid postage label for a distant swap
membership.freeBlurb: Everything you need to swap with your neighbours.
membership.collectorBlurb: A wider map and more finds on the table at once.
membership.curatorBlurb: For people who swap constantly and want to be seen first.

radius.title: Hunt further out
radius.body: Collector opens the whole city and 50 km around it.
radius.free: Or wait — new finds land within 10 km every day.

live_finds.title: Keep more finds live
live_finds.body: Hunter holds six at a time. Collector has no cap.
live_finds.free: Or pause an older find to make room — nothing is deleted.

active_swaps.title: More swaps at once
active_swaps.body: Hunter runs three at a time so nobody gets left waiting.
active_swaps.free: Or finish one of yours first.

see_eyeing.title: See who is eyeing this
see_eyeing.body: Collector shows you who, so you can offer them something first.

saved_search.title: Instant alerts
saved_search.body: Collector saves five searches and tells you the moment one lands.
saved_search.free: Your first search still arrives in the daily digest.

after_fourth_swap.title: Four swaps in. Nicely done.
after_fourth_swap.body: Collector widens the map and lifts the caps, if you want more of this.
after_fourth_swap.free: Staying on Hunter changes nothing about what you already have.

someone_likes_yours.title: People are eyeing this one
someone_likes_yours.body: Unlock who they are and you can offer them something first.

stack_empty.title: That is everything nearby
stack_empty.body: Collector opens the map out to 50 km, so there is more to see.
stack_empty.free: Or widen the radius yourself — new finds land every day.

just_passed.title: Changed your mind?
just_passed.body: Collector lets you rewind as far back as you like.
just_passed.free: Your last pass is always free to undo.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Bartefy is written in English and translated from it.
settings.blockedBody: They cannot see your finds or message you, and you will not see theirs.
settings.blockedEmptyBody: When you block someone, they show up here so you can undo it later.
settings.unblockBody: You will both be able to see each other's finds and send messages again.
settings.unblockFailed: That did not go through. Try again in a moment.
settings.replayTipsHelp: Replays the welcome tour and brings back every tip you dismissed.
settings.emailBody: {{email}} — you sign in with a 6-digit code sent here. No password to forget.
settings.areaBody: {{city}} — only the area shows, never an address.
settings.signOutBody: On this device. Your finds and swaps stay as they are.

settings.deleteBody: This asks us to delete your account. You are signed out now, and your account and finds are removed when the request is processed.
settings.saveFailed: That did not save. Check your signal and try again.
settings.notifMatchHelp: When an offer is accepted or a swap is agreed.
settings.notifMessageHelp: When someone writes to you in a swap.
settings.notifEmailHelp: A short email when things wait for you.
settings.pushNote: Push alerts are being rebuilt; these choices are kept for when they are back.
settings.privacyWhoBody: Others see your name, your area and how many swaps you have done. Never your finds as a list, your points or your tier.
settings.privacyAreaBody: Never stored. You agree where to meet in the chat.
settings.membershipBody: Tiers are bought with points you earn. See what each one adds.

help.whatIsBartefy: Bartefy is a straight swap: your item for theirs. No money changes hands.
help.whyWants: Saying what you want helps us show your find to the right people. Leaving it open gets you more offers.
help.whyCondition: Being honest about wear builds the trust the whole trade runs on.
help.whyEyeing: How many people have saved this find. Popular things move fast.
help.whyBlindRating: Neither rating is shown until you have both rated, so nobody is influenced.
help.whyPublicSpot: Public places keep both of you safe and give you an easy exit.
help.whyNoMoney: Bartefy is trade-only. If someone asks you for money, report it.

stuck.title: Not sure what is next?
stuck.listFirst: You have not listed anything yet. A profile with a find on the table gets far more offers.
stuck.noSwipes: Start swiping to find your first match.
stuck.waitingOnThem: You have said your piece — it is with them now. We will nudge you when they reply.
stuck.arrangeNext: You have both agreed. Next step is picking a time and place.
stuck.confirmNext: You met up — confirm you got your item so the swap can close.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: What people actually do, and which version wins.
analytics.funnelHelp: People who ever reached each step, not totals. The number beside each step is the change from the step above — a step can go up, since someone can match without swiping if the other person made the offer.
analytics.noEvents: No events yet. They start arriving once people use the app.
analytics.noExperiments: No experiments yet. Add one to start testing a feature two ways.
analytics.verdictReady: Both sides have enough people for this to mean something. Read it alongside what you know about the change.
analytics.verdictEarly: Too early to call. Each side needs at least {{min}} people before a difference means anything — until then this is a description, not a verdict.
analytics.keyHelp: What the code asks for: useExperiment('your_key'). Lower case, underscores.
analytics.whatPlaceholder: e.g. Wishlist prompt first, instead of widen radius
analytics.notWired: No one has been put in this test yet. Either nobody has reached the screen since it started, or no code calls useExperiment('{{key}}') — a running experiment that nothing asks for can never collect data.
analytics.configHelp_like_ttl_hours: How long a free like waits for the other person. Changing it applies to every waiting like, counted from when it was made — anything older expires within 15 minutes.
analytics.configHelp_offer_ttl_hours: How long a paid offer waits for an answer. Changing it applies to new offers only; waiting ones keep the clock their sender saw.

ob.welcomeBody: Bartefy is a straight trade: your thing for their thing. Here is how it works.
ob.step1: 1. Put a find on the table
ob.step1Body: Photograph something you no longer need. Say what you’d like back.
ob.step2Body: Swipe finds near you, at random. Offer one of yours for what you like — nobody is told when you pass.
ob.step3Body: When they say yes, a chat opens. Meet up, swap, and both confirm. No money changes hands.
ob.cityBody: We only show finds you could realistically go and collect.
ob.cityNotePost: . Change your area any time in Settings — only the area ever shows, never an address.
ob.tasteBody: Pick a few. This only shapes your first few cards — you can change it any time.
ob.tastePicked: {{n}} picked — your first cards lean that way.
ob.tasteNone: Nothing picked — you’ll see a bit of everything.
ob.doneBody: Start by putting one thing on the table. A find on the table gets far more offers — and it’s how others find you.
ob.doneStreak: Your streak starts today: come back tomorrow for +{{n}}.
ob.capCity: Near enough to go and collect.
ob.capTaste: Your first cards, a little closer to you.
